newEntry.name: Skein & Cross
newEntry.desc: Snip eight runners, seat a T spine in a perpendicular crossarm and loosely wind four open tips to gather a miniature yarn hank. Measured sheet/socket reference, calibrated tongue fit and ergonomic grips; local PNG/JPEG/SVG relief and verified ASCII/binary STL grips, connected-card, two-part STL and assembly ZIP. Yarn, ties and adhesive required; physical winding and release untested.
